exam_scheme.note: The Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) is conducted by the Consortium of National Law Universities for admissions to the 5-year integrated undergraduate (UG) law programmes (BA LLB, BBA LLB, B.Sc LLB, B.Com LLB) across 24 participating NLUs. The UG CLAT is a 2-hour pen-and-paper offline examination consisting of 120 multiple-choice questions based on reading comprehension passages of approximately 450 words each across 5 sections. Marking scheme: 1 mark for each correct answer and negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
